Actions.Text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO WOMEN'S ISSUES

Title: Requires health care providers facilitate a screening for maternal depression within a certain time frame
Summary: Requires health care providers facilitate a screening for maternal depression, unless refused by the birth mother, prior to the patient leaving the birthing facility and during the first postnatal visit, and that such screening be covered by insurance.
LawCode: Amd §2500-k, Pub Health L; amd §§3216, 3221, 4303 & 3217-g, Ins L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law and the insurance law, in relation to requiring maternal depression screenings and that such screenings are covered by insurance
